Title: Pahadi Bhaang Loon (Traditional Hemp Seed Salt) - 100g
Body (HTML):
Authentic Himalayan Bhaang Loon, traditionally hand-crushed on stone (Sil-Batta) with roasted hemp seeds, pure rock salt, and aromatic mountain spices.

Hailing from the high hills of Uttarakhand, Bhaang Loon is one of the most celebrated culinary traditions of the Pahadi kitchen. Made by slowly crushing roasted Himalayan hemp seeds (Bhaang ke beej) together with natural pink rock salt, cumin, and indigenous herbs on a heavy granite stone (Sil-Batta). The gentle pressure of stone-grinding extracts and infuses the rich natural oils of the hemp seeds into every grain of salt, yielding an irresistibly nutty, warm, and earthy flavor.

Why You'll Love It:

  • Ancestral Sil-Batta Grinding: Cold stone-pressed to lock in authentic flavors and vital essential oils.
  • Nutritious Himalayan Hemp: 100% non-intoxicating roasted hemp seeds packed with natural plant proteins, Omega-3 & 6, and dietary minerals.
  • 100% Natural & Pure: No preservatives, synthetic colors, anti-caking chemicals, or artificial aromas.
  • Versatile Daily Pairing: Ideal for sprinkling on fresh fruits (guava, apple, cucumber), raita, morning curd, roasted makhana, boiled eggs, salads, and warm ghee parathas.
